body:
## Code Review

This pull request introduces authentication and visibility constraints to the question search functionality. It requires an authenticated `userId` or public-only visibility posture to perform searches, failing closed with an authentication error otherwise. Additionally, it restricts search results to public questions (where `source_kind` is 'paper_question'), filtering out imported or private questions. Unit tests across the API, service, and repository layers have been updated to reflect these changes. I have no feedback to provide as there are no review comments.
